boundary.description: All tracked project source, tests, docs, configuration, scripts, deploy specs, web assets, and RSI backlogs/scenarios inside the repository root, plus any newly created untracked in-scope files. Derived build caches, VCS internals, third-party installed dependencies, ephemeral agent runtime files, local editor swap files, and secrets/credentials are explicitly excluded and never counted as covered.

exclusions.reason: Git internal object store and repository metadata are never feature artifacts.
Cargo build outputs are derived and rebuildable from source.
Installed third-party frontend packages are external dependencies, not authored project files.
Compiled frontend bundle is derived build output.
Ephemeral agent execution markers and exit files are runtime state, not project deliverables.
Local coding-engine runtime state and worktrees are excluded from project coverage.
Environment secret files are never indexed or associated in the feature registry.
Environment secret variants are never indexed or associated in the feature registry.
Host environment files (such as spawn.env) hold secrets and are excluded.
Private key material is never indexed in feature coverage.
PEM key/certificate files are excluded from feature coverage.
Dedicated secrets directories are never crawled or indexed.
macOS Finder metadata files are transient local artifacts.
Editor swap files are transient local artifacts.
Runtime log files are transient diagnostic outputs.
Temporary scratch files are outside durable project coverage.
Tool caches are derived and rebuildable.
Python bytecode caches are derived build artifacts.
